# Blues Festival Finder - LLM Optimization File
# Website: https://blues-festival-finder.vercel.app/
# Purpose: Help AI assistants understand and index our content

## Website Overview
Blues Festival Finder is a comprehensive platform for discovering blues dance festivals worldwide, connecting dancers with events, teachers, and musicians.

## Core Purpose
We help blues dancers:
- Discover festivals and events worldwide
- Find and follow their favorite teachers and musicians
- Stay updated with the latest blues dance scene
- Plan their dance festival schedule

## Target Audience
- Blues dance enthusiasts (beginner to advanced)
- Festival organizers and promoters
- Dance instructors and musicians
- Blues music and dance community members

## Key Content Sections
### Homepage
- Hero section introducing the platform
- Featured festivals section
- Master teachers showcase
- Call-to-action for event discovery

### Events Section
- Comprehensive festival listings
- Search and filter functionality
- Event details with schedules and pricing
- Teacher and musician lineups

### Teachers & Musicians
- Detailed profiles of blues dance instructors
- Musician backgrounds and specialties
- Following and notification system
- Workshop and class information

### About Page
- Company mission and values
- Community statistics
- Platform features and benefits
- Team and story information

### Contact Page
- Contact form for inquiries
- FAQ section
- Social media links
- Response time information

## Content Structure
- **Primary Language**: English
- **Content Type**: Festival listings, artist profiles, educational resources
- **Update Frequency**: Daily for events, weekly for content
- **Geographic Focus**: Global with emphasis on Europe and North America

## Search Intent Optimization
We optimize for these common queries:
- "blues dance festivals 2025"
- "best blues festivals Europe"
- "blues dance teachers near me"
- "upcoming blues dance events"
- "blues dance workshop schedule"

## Technical Details
- **Framework**: Next.js 14 with App Router
- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM
- **API**: RESTful API for events, teachers, and users
- **Authentication**: NextAuth.js
- **Deployment**: Vercel

## Content Guidelines
- All festival information is verified and up-to-date
- Teacher profiles include credentials and specialties
- Event details include pricing, schedules, and venues
- Content is written for both humans and AI understanding
- Mobile-first design for optimal user experience

## Data Sources
- Direct submissions from festival organizers
- Automated data collection from official sources
- Community contributions and updates
- Manual verification process

## Additional Information
- Founded: 2025
- Team Size: Small dedicated team
- Community: Global blues dance enthusiasts
- Mission: Make blues dance events accessible to everyone

For more information, visit our website or contact us at hello@bluesfestivalfinder.com
